source_note: Context7 MCP server (@upstash/context7-mcp 4.1.1, keyless, installed once by setup_context7.sh and started with node: through npx it took 24-70 s to start and failed in 2 of 4 pilot runs) on the docs fixture: helpdesk-ai pinned to the Vercel AI SDK ai@7.0.128 (AI SDK 7, released 25 June 2026, after Haiku 4.5's training data). With: the server via --mcp-config, its tools allowed, and the README's own Claude Code rule in CLAUDE.md ('Always use Context7 when I need library/API documentation...'). Without: no MCP server, no CLAUDE.md, the model's own knowledge plus the installed package (its bundled docs/ folder, sources and CHANGELOG are stripped from node_modules on both sides). No web tools on either side. Graders fail a changed version pin or lockfile, an installed ai other than 7.0.128, names AI SDK 7 removed, and the hidden behaviour tests. Context7 calls per run come from the saved events (count_calls.py). Both sides may also run `npm test` (allowed_tools_extra): in the pilot every run that tried to test reached for `npm test`, which the lab's tool list denies, and then stopped testing.
